excerpt: The source defines |C> = exp(T - T†)|Phi_ref>, T = T1 + T2 + ... + TN, and states that for fixed excitation level k the reduced cluster operator contains O(N^k(M-N)^k) terms. After Jordan-Wigner transformation, the preparation reduces to quantum simulation of a Hamiltonian that is a polynomial sum of Pauli products.
overview: This formal argument explains why chemistry-motivated ansatz preparation can be plausible on quantum hardware while remaining hard for known classical methods. It grounds the scalability discussion in the structure of coupled-cluster operators rather than only in the small photonic demonstration.
title: Unitary Cluster Ansatz Form
